# Shared Live Source Map

<!-- Generated by tools/render_source_registry_docs.py from docs/skills/shared/references/live-source-registry.yaml -->

Use these shared live-source roles for live checks on top of the local snapshot in data/current/. The active regulation and its official announcement are discovered automatically and stored in data/current/regulation.json; browse live only for what happened after the snapshot or what the snapshot cannot show.

Official sources define legality and active mechanics. Community sources describe what players are doing inside that legal format. Supporting sources sharpen set and event context after the core format and usage picture are grounded.

## Official Format Sources

### Pokémon Champions in-game news (official)

Role: `official_regulation`
Kind: `official`
Canonical URL: https://champions-news.pokemon-home.com/en/list
Freshness: re-check within 7 days; The concrete announcement for the active regulation is `official_url` in data/current/regulation.json; re-open it live for species, move or item eligibility questions.
Active regulation: discovered at runtime; see `regulation_id`, `active_window` and `official_url` in `data/current/regulation.json`
Required evidence fields: `source_id`, `source_url`, `fetched_at`, `format_window`, `active_mechanics`, `claim_type`

Use for:

- active regulation dates and announced next regulation
- active mechanics
- eligible Pokémon, held item rules and timers

Do not use for:

- tournament usage claims
- prevalence claims about specific teams or cores
- set tendency claims

Counts toward the recommended minimum live stack.

Fallback if unavailable:

- Use data/current/regulation.json and say when it was last checked.
- If no current official rules source is available, do not make present-tense legality or mechanics claims beyond what the regulation file states.

### Play! Pokemon transition announcement

Role: `official_transition`
Kind: `official`
Canonical URL: https://www.pokemon.com/uk/pokemon-news/play-pokemon-competitions-transition-to-pokemon-champions-on-april-and-may-2026
Freshness: re-check within 30 days; Historical context only; pokemon.com is for manual reading (it blocks automated clients).
Required evidence fields: `source_id`, `source_url`, `fetched_at`, `published_at`, `claim_type`

Use for:

- historical context for the transition from Pokemon Scarlet and Violet to Pokemon Champions

Do not use for:

- legality or mechanics overrides
- usage claims
- set tendency claims

Fallback if unavailable:

- Omit transition claims rather than guessing.

## Community Meta Sources

### VGC History

Role: `tournament_meta`
Kind: `community`
Canonical URL: https://vgchistory.com/tournaments
Freshness: re-check within 7 days; Primary in-person source of the local snapshot; check live only for official events newer than the snapshot's data_through.
Required evidence fields: `source_id`, `source_url`, `fetched_at`, `claim_type`, `sample_scope`, `freshness_note`

Use for:

- whole-field standings, records and open team sheets of official in-person events
- day 2 and top cut teams

Do not use for:

- legality or mechanics claims
- online or ladder usage claims

Counts toward the recommended minimum live stack.

Fallback if unavailable:

- Use limitlessvgc.com tournament pages (day 2 team lists) and say which source replaced it.
- If no in-person source is available, keep in-person conclusions to the local snapshot and state its age.

### Limitless VGC

Role: `tournament_meta`
Kind: `community`
Canonical URL: https://limitlessvgc.com/tournaments
Freshness: re-check within 7 days; Fallback in-person source; shows day 2 team lists with the regulation of each event.
Required evidence fields: `source_id`, `source_url`, `fetched_at`, `claim_type`, `sample_scope`, `freshness_note`

Use for:

- official event results and day 2 team lists, labeled by regulation

Do not use for:

- legality or mechanics claims
- whole-field usage claims (it lists day 2 teams only)

Fallback if unavailable:

- Use VGC History or the local snapshot and label the gap.

### Limitless tournament platform (online)

Role: `broader_meta`
Kind: `community`
Canonical URL: https://play.limitlesstcg.com/tournaments?game=VGC
Freshness: re-check within 7 days; Online complement of the local snapshot (64+ player events); check live only for events newer than the snapshot.
Required evidence fields: `source_id`, `source_url`, `fetched_at`, `claim_type`, `sample_scope`, `freshness_note`

Use for:

- online tournament usage, records and team lists

Do not use for:

- legality or mechanics claims
- in-person or official event claims

Counts toward the recommended minimum live stack.

Fallback if unavailable:

- Use Pikalytics tournament pages and label the replacement.
- If broader usage coverage is missing, keep current-field claims to the in-person snapshot.

## Supporting Sources

### Pikalytics Champions

Role: `supporting_sets`
Kind: `supporting`
Canonical URL: https://www.pikalytics.com/ai/pokedex
Freshness: re-check within 7 days; Re-check live before set, partner, move, item, or ability tendency claims that the snapshot does not cover.
Required evidence fields: `source_id`, `source_url`, `fetched_at`, `claim_type`, `sample_scope`, `freshness_note`

Use for:

- set tendencies
- common partners
- move, item, and ability expectations

Do not use for:

- legality or mechanics claims
- source-of-truth usage claims
- official event timing claims

Fallback if unavailable:

- Use the sets section of the local snapshot.
- If no supporting set source is available, keep set details broader instead of inventing exact tendencies.

### Victory Road

Role: `editorial_context`
Kind: `editorial`
Canonical URL: https://victoryroad.pro/
Freshness: re-check within 14 days; Re-check live before event context, tournament coverage, or editorial interpretation claims.
Required evidence fields: `source_id`, `source_url`, `fetched_at`, `published_at`, `claim_type`, `freshness_note`

Use for:

- event context and upcoming event calendar
- tournament coverage
- human-written competitive interpretation

Do not use for:

- legality or mechanics claims
- sole proof of current prevalence
- exact set legality claims

Fallback if unavailable:

- Answer from the verified official and snapshot stack without adding extra narrative certainty.

## Recommended Minimum Live Stack

For most current-meta questions and current-field team recommendations, use at least:

1. 1 official regulation source
2. 1 tournament-focused community source
3. 1 broader usage/community source

If those disagree materially, say so and keep the conclusion directional.
